what_worked:
Completed investigation of ML metrics collection:
1. Fixed test isolation bug in temp_experiments_dir fixture (was polluting metrics.jsonl)
2. Cleaned 25 polluted entries from metrics.jsonl
3. Identified root cause of 99.6% data loss: hooks in project settings.local.json weren't running because global settings.json was overriding
4. Fixed by adding project-specific hooks to global ~/.claude/settings.json with cwd:Opus-code-test matcher
5. Updated CLAUDE.md with comprehensive ML documentation

Key learnings:
- Claude Code hooks need to be in global settings.json for reliability
- Project-level settings.local.json may be ignored when global hooks exist
- Test fixtures must patch ALL relevant module constants, not just the direct ones
